evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Mandating a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to stability (conservation) and capability-readiness (competence) as the goods being secured.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed with non-existent frames mastery-through-practice as the condition for genuine capability.
Restating the cadence as a labeled property reinforces the stability and routine being institutionalized.
Naming a single owner appeals to self-origination — one person accountable on their own authority.

mints.name: RehearsalAsPossession
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is capability here being framed as something you only possess through practiced rehearsal, not through design alone?
